# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines

- Follow the Universal Project Coding & Management Guide found in `.ai-ley/shared/global-instructions.md`
- Read `GRAPHICS-APPEARANCE-AND-BEHAVIOR.txt` at session start and before changing plant graphics, equipment symbols, palette, piping/layout, state colors, or Control Studio presentation. Preserve its reference-based appearance and feedback behavior; do not redesign protected visuals without explicit user direction. Follow its regression checklist for relevant code changes.
